snippet.title: SKY WORLD 64 – Official Teaser Trailer (2025)
snippet.description:
Sky World 64 is a brand-new indie game that harkens back to the 64-bit era of gaming! Take a trip back to Nostalgia Land in this cozy sandbox adventure that takes place in the sky! This experience takes heavy inspiration from Minecraft’s Sky Block, as you will need to use the limited resources you have to survive and turn your tiny island into a big world full of life! More info will be shared in the future, so stay tuned!
